patch.objective: Overseeing a privacy and security plan: PII governance protocols, encryption/access controls for training data, and privacy impact assessments
secondaryObjectives: Monitoring regulatory and policy compliance: tracking evolving AI regulations and coordinating with legal/compliance teams on governance

sources.cite: PMI Certified Professional in Managing AI (PMI-CPMAI) Examination Content Outline (September 2025): Responsible and Trustworthy AI 15%, Business Needs and Solutions 26%, Data Needs 26%, Model Development and Evaluation 16%, Operationalize 17%
sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch of a training provider's syllabus page that restates the outline in its own words (PMI's PDF did not come up in search). Restated: data evaluation (assess data quality; analyze distributions for bias or gaps; exploratory data analysis); model governance (lifecycle management, versioning and change control, monitor performance and detect drift). The objective wording here is the course seed's; PMI's own wording is to verify. Reused for REQ-336 from this course's loan-data-bias-pmicpmai (the same reading and date); the objective wording is the course seed's.

The organization, the project, the figures and the people are fictional. The minutes or days each step takes and the effects of each decision are teaching simplifications for exam practice, not measured values.
